title: Security Groups Config Schema
description: Phase 2 configuration: the Microsoft Entra security groups to create, with the RBAC roles they receive against the resource groups declared in resource-groups.jsonc.

securityGroups.description: Microsoft Entra security groups to create once the resource groups exist. Created as phase 2, ahead of any per-environment identity or GitHub environment resources.

displayName.description: Display name of the Microsoft Entra security group.

mailNickname.description: Mail nickname (alias) of the security group.

description.description: Optional description of the security group.

resourceGroupId.description: Id of the resource group (from resource-groups.jsonc) this role is scoped to. The command resolves this to the resource group's full Azure resource ID, which allows cross-environment role assignments without duplicating naming logic. Mutually exclusive with 'scope'.

scope.description: Set to 'subscription' to assign this role at the subscription scope instead of a single resource group. Mutually exclusive with 'resourceGroupId'.
